annotations.title: Alcohol seller training and age check for a liquor or convenience store shift schedule, by state, with sources (signed)

description: Alcohol seller training and age check for a liquor store or convenience store schedule (off-premise sales). Send the state, store_type, staff (a staff code, hired_on, certified_on = date of the seller-training certificate, age_band) and shifts (date + staff codes). Get the state's rule as read on its own pages (training required or voluntary, deadline after hire, renewal, minimum seller age, supervision), each staff member's due and expiry dates, and every shift where someone would sell untrained, past the deadline, on an expired certificate, under age, or without a required older person on the shift. States: AK, CA, FL, LA, MT, NM, OR, TX, UT, VT, WA. check_sources true also fetches the state's official pages and signs their hashes (20 an hour per caller). Signed record. No names; stores nothing; no model. Free: 120 calls an hour per caller. Docs: https://llpro.ai/shift-scheduling-plus-alcohol

as_of.description: Date to report staff status on (default today, UTC).

check_sources.description: Also fetch the state's official pages now and sign each page's hash.

id.description: Your shift id, e.g. fri-pm (optional; not a name).

staff.description: Codes of the staff who sell alcohol on this shift.

certified_on.description: Date the current seller-training certificate or permit was issued (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if none.

code.description: A staff code such as E12 (not a name).

state.description: Two-letter code of the state where the store is, e.g. TX.

store_type.description: convenience_store (also grocery or gas station selling packaged beer or wine; default) or liquor_store (a package store whose main business is alcohol).
